economic_hypothesis: A high-turnover bearish displacement candle creates an objective traded overhead-supply zone between its close and open. After price has spent a meaningful interval completely below that zone, a later high-participation close back into its lower portion may reveal that trapped supply is being absorbed and create a measurable repair path toward the frozen upper boundary.
independence: This is a traded bearish-candle body, not the untraded adjacent-session true-gap structure used by V26. No true-gap, collapse-gap, V13, V26, or V27 identity is used.

scientific_periods.frozen_rule_confirmation: 2021-01-01 through 2021-12-31; signal outcomes remain unread until chart rules are frozen

formation_bar: PIT hard-valid, fully tradable, non-ST bar in one valid corporate-action coordinate lineage.
Formation close location is in the bottom 30% of its range.
Formation low <= the minimum low of the preceding 20 completed sessions.
mother_event.frozen_zone: L = formation coordinate close; U = formation coordinate open. Both boundaries are known at formation close and never revised.
mother_event.departure: Within 60 market-session indices after formation, the stock completes a session whose coordinate high is strictly below L.
mother_event.persistence: A strong re-entry signal cannot occur until at least 20 market-session indices after the first complete-below session.
mother_event.zone_integrity: No completed post-formation/pre-signal coordinate high may reach U.
signal: Occurs no later than 120 market-session indices after formation.
Completed coordinate close is >= the preceding session coordinate high.
Close location is in the top 30% of the signal range.
mother_event.primary_zone: If several zones produce the same symbol/signal session, retain the most recently formed intact zone.
mother_event.overlap_control: After retaining an event, the same symbol requires more than 120 market-session indices before another retained event; this prevents overlapping 120-session zone lifecycles from being treated as independent.

decision_and_execution.entry: first legal executable daily open strictly after the signal, no later than the third subsequent market-session index
decision_and_execution.entry_headroom: U / executable entry coordinate - 1 >= 4.4%, providing at least 4.0% net target payoff after the frozen 40 bp round-trip cost
decision_and_execution.target: frozen zone upper boundary U, eligible from the first T+1 sellable session
decision_and_execution.time_stop: after 20 completed market-session indices, exit at the next legal sellable open

chart_anatomy.window: 126 market-session indices before and after signal where observable

causality.state_timestamp: Every formation, zone, departure, persistence, integrity, and signal field is known by signal close.

amendments: A prior-60-session +20% strength condition was rejected before outcomes because it produced only 6-75 raw events in several years; prior strength is retained as an anatomy descriptor rather than a mother-event gate.

A 20-session complete-below persistence and 5% remaining-zone headroom were selected for structural meaning and verified to preserve more than 50 raw events in every development year. No outcome was read during this coverage audit.

prohibited: No true-gap or V26 identity reuse.
No future bar in formation, zone, signal, or market state.
No signal-bar entry or T+0 target exit.
No mother-event threshold change after development outcomes are attached.
No 2021 signal outcome read before chart-rule freeze.
No 2022-2024 outcome read unless the full development gate passes.
No machine learning, feature subset search, or threshold grid.
